currency.description: Currency code of the digital asset to withdraw.

net_type.description:
Withdrawal network type.

Blockchain network identifier used by Upbit. The `net_type` parameter in withdrawal requests must match this value.

[Example] "ETH", "TRX", "SOL"

network_name.description:
Withdrawal network name displayed to users.

[Example] "Ethereum", "Bitcoin", "Tron", "Solana"

withdraw_address.description:
Recipient address for digital asset withdrawal.

Only addresses registered in the allowed withdrawal address list can be used.

secondary_address.description:
Secondary withdrawal address (Destination Tag, Memo, or Message).
Some digital assets require a secondary address along with the primary address.

beneficiary_name.description:
Name of the wallet owner.

Name of the individual or corporate representative receiving the withdrawn assets. Returned only for exchange wallets; null for personal wallets.

beneficiary_company_name.description: Company name of the entity receiving the withdrawn assets.

beneficiary_type.description:
Account holder type.
  - `individual`: Personal wallet
  - `corporate`: Corporate wallet

exchange_name.description:
Name of the exchange where the withdrawal address is registered.

[Example] "Binance", "Bybit"
